reading.title: Sorting the Socks
reading.purpose: Hear how to sort, match, and count socks.
paras: On laundry day, we sort the socks. We match each sock with its pair. Two socks that are the same make a pair.
Dad's socks are different from mine. His are big, and mine are small. We count the pairs. We count six!

qs.q: We match each sock with its pair. What do we do?
choices: Put two that are alike together.
qs.why: To match means to pair up two things that are alike.

qs.q: How are Dad's socks different from mine?
qs.why: His socks are big, and mine are small.

qs.q: Two socks make a pair. Which two make a pair?
choices: Two socks that are the same.
A big sock and a small sock.
qs.why: The reading says two socks that are the same make a pair.

reading.retellFrame: We sort the socks, and then we ___.
